description: Lint an AI agent context file (CLAUDE.md, .claude/rules/ files, AGENTS.md, Cursor rules, Copilot instructions, memory files) with PromptArch's deterministic linter: ~30 research-backed rule families covering current-model anti-patterns (tool-forcing, reasoning-echo, sycophancy triggers, contradictions), per-tool size budgets, secrets/dangerous commands, and hidden-Unicode injection ("Rules File Backdoor"). Returns grade, 0-100 score, and line-anchored findings. Free: no account or credits needed.
